noun_definition: Message count refers to the number of characters in the final HTML converted text of a message, which should be used to determine if the message can be sent or updated, rather than the number of characters typed by the user.

Character refers to the individual units of text that are counted in the user interface when sending or editing messages, as opposed to the actual length of the HTML-converted text that the backend can accept.
ui refers to the user interface where users type and send messages, which currently counts the typed characters instead of the final HTML character count, leading to API request failures.

html character refers to the length of the text after it has been converted to HTML format, which should be used to determine the allowable character count for sending or editing messages in the application.

api request refers to the action of sending or updating a message in the chat system, which fails when the character count exceeds the limit set by the backend due to incorrect calculation of the message length based on typed characters instead of the final HTML converted text.
